about: Ages (Ma) at which land vegetation changes the look of continents in the paleo biome classifier. Hand-entered; the transitions were gradual, so the classifier fades over a few Myr. Approximate.

rows.source: Earliest land-plant spores (cryptospores), Middle Ordovician: Wellman, Osterloff & Mohiuddin 2003, Nature 425, 282-285
Earliest forests (Gilboa, Middle Devonian): Stein et al. 2007, Nature 446, 904-907
Spread of grass-dominated habitats in the Miocene: Strömberg 2011, Annu. Rev. Earth Planet. Sci. 39, 517-544
